runs.name: Siemens AG
runs.entry: Price **EUR 272.10** a Xetra ordinary share (SIE, close 2026-10-09, Yahoo chart, aggregator, flagged; the company's 15th interim buyback report gives EUR 271.05 bought that day); ADS **USD 153.36** (OTC close 2026-10-12, same aggregator, flagged), one ADS = one-half share by Amendment No. 2 to the deposit agreement (F-6 POS exhibit, 2017-03-08, acc 0001193805-17-000417, no later amendment on EDGAR); EUR/USD 1.1187 (aggregator, flagged). Not an SEC registrant: documents and dates stand in place of accessions. Shares **768.1 million** built from the FY2025 Note 19 (800,000,000 issued, 19,735,802 treasury), the half-year report's Note 5 (18 million cancelled March 2026) and the buyback reports to 2026-10-11 (CONVENTION of this run: employee transfers after 2026-03-31 unpublished and left out, under 0.3%); cap **EUR 209,000M**. Sovereign **3.78%** (EUR; ECB 30-year AAA spot, 2026-10-09). Documents read: Siemens Report for fiscal 2025 (dated 2025-12-01), the annual reports FY2016 to FY2024 (ten balance sheets), the Half-year Financial Report FY2026 (2026-05-04), the Q3 FY2026 Earnings Release (2026-08-06), the press release of 2026-04-17, the buyback pages. One figure cross-checked: FY2025 free cash flow EUR 11,004M against operating cash 13,448 less additions 2,445 in the cash-flow statement. `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` do not serve a non-SEC name; arithmetic by hand (`q7_calc.py`). The Healthineers spin-off (announced 2025-11-12) has not taken place: the vote is set for the February 2027 AGM; Siemens holds 67% after selling 2%; valued consolidated with the minority deducted. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's organization and segment sections, risk report, results discussion, Note 22 and the Compensation Report. Competitors: rivals named in the reports' compensation peer groups and Mobility section; three SEC filers read from their 10-Ks (Rockwell against Digital Industries, Eaton against Smart Infrastructure, GE HealthCare against Healthineers, flagged that the reports name General Electric); ABB, Schneider, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Alstom, Hitachi and an unnamed Chinese rail rival flagged as non-filers, not read. **Q1 IN** read by parts: Digital Industries decides at 34% of five-year Industrial profit, margins 15% to 23% FY2016 to FY2025 and 18.3% in nine months of FY2026; the analyst recorded doubt on its software half (about 35% of its revenue, the risk report's own AI warning) and wrote that a second analyst could close TOO HARD (NATURE) there. **Q2 IN**: Digital Industries' decade of margins beside Rockwell's 19% to 22%, prices passed through the 2022 to 2023 inflation (19.9% to 22.6%); against it FY2025 at 14.9% and price pressure in China. **Q3 weighs for** (high returns on the capital needed, spending about depreciation). **Q4 weighs against**, no confusion: EPS pre PPA featured, annual guidance raised in the year; ten balance sheets read (goodwill and intangibles EUR 31.9bn to 52.9bn against equity 68.4bn, tangible equity about EUR 9bn, pension provision 13.7bn to 0.7bn; about EUR 29bn of the 56bn debt funds the SFS book; industrial net debt EUR 9.3bn in June 2026). **Q5 integrity IN**: every open matter in Note 22 is conduct of 1992 to 2011. **Q6 weighs against**: a serial acquirer, net purchases EUR 23.4bn against owner cash of 42.1bn over five years; Altair (EUR 9.5bn) and Dotmatics (EUR 3.3bn) at over ten times revenue; the 2024 to 2026 buyback averaged EUR 212.28, below the range bottom, the 2026 programme EUR 274.20, above it. **Q7 OUT**: owner cash EUR 8,427M (FY2021 to FY2025 average: free cash flow less stock pay less the minority's share of net income; EUR 7,241M after interest); net debt EUR 27,807M at 2026-06-30 (SFS debt and leases in, 2026 buyback cash added, EUR 12.4bn of listed stakes out as securities, a CONVENTION of this run); floor tested first: at EUR 236,807M for the whole business no case earns it (about 6.0% a year on organic growth of 6.71%, the serial-acquirer pair, 3.6% at no growth); range **EUR 254.06 to 475.40 a share** (ADS EUR 127.03 to 237.70, USD 142.11 to 265.91 at 1.1187) against EUR 272.10; beside it the default pair 254.06 to 395.30, securities not deducted 237.89 to 459.23, the industrial basis 268.64 to 467.98, equity-only 265.57 to 455.76. Fair price **EUR 105.73 a share all-equity** (ADS EUR 52.86, about USD 59.14), equity-only EUR 138.12 (ADS about USD 77.26); beside: default pair 78.76, securities not deducted 89.56, industrial basis 135.06. Q8 to Q12 not reached. Confessed departure: the Q7 script was committed in the Q1 commit before Q1 to Q4 closed in the run file; its results entered only at Q7. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening git status (SQFT commit subjects, other names' folder names), the `Screens/_daily/` listing, a memory line with counts not naming Siemens; nothing used. Commits 042c16a1, 6d8843ca, 71ab2983, 3fb424d3, 324d5f9e (Q5 to Q7 together, for Q6's buyback line). Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check.py`) found every id in the ledger and no E-id, and **two slips**: the framework's own words "standing castle that protects only ordinary returns" quoted beside **[L2007-004]** (Q2), and "would need a pencil" in quotation marks beside **[M2009-005]**, **[M1996-084]**, words neither row contains (Q7); a third hit is a filing quotation, not a slip. Recorded here, not fixed in the run file. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the all-equity basis has no rule for a captive lender (SFS's EUR 29bn book: its debt in net debt while its interest income stays in owner cash); (2) whether listed equity stakes count as "securities" in net debt; (3) no rule for deducting a consolidated subsidiary's minority; (4) at what figure stock pay is deducted when the filer's free cash flow excludes it; (5) Q1's doubt rule does not say whether doubt about a third of the deciding part keeps the whole outside; (6) the share count for a filer that publishes no treasury count at the latest quarter; (7) the brief's Q6-with-Q7 commit against commit-after-each-question. Could not get: a treasury count after 2026-03-31, current tradable securities at 2026-06-30, a stated maintenance capital figure; competitor figures are XBRL transcription with Rockwell FY2025 cross-checked.
runs.narr: Q7 OUT, on price: a German industrial and medical-technology group read by parts, Digital Industries deciding; Q1 IN (doubt recorded on the software half, a second analyst could close TOO HARD), Q2 IN on a decade of margins beside Rockwell's and prices held through the inflation; Q3 weighs for, Q4 weighs against (EPS pre PPA, guidance), Q5 integrity IN (legacy matters 1992 to 2011), Q6 weighs against (a serial acquirer, Altair and Dotmatics at over ten times revenue). At EUR 272.10 no case earns the floor; range EUR 254.06 to 475.40 a share; fair price EUR 105.73 all-equity (ADS about USD 59.14), EUR 138.12 equity-only. The Healthineers spin-off is set for a vote in February 2027 and is not valued.
